# Extract gender and age group from target_audience
# Example: "Men 18-24" -> gender = "Men", age_group = "18-24"
df[['Gender', 'Age_Group']] = df['target_audience'].str.split(' ', 1, expand=True)

# Calculate average engagement score by gender and age group
avg_engagement = df.groupby(['Gender', 'Age_Group'])['engagement_score'].mean().reset_index()

# Find the segment with the highest average engagement score
highest_engagement_segment = avg_engagement.loc[avg_engagement['engagement_score'].idxmax()]

result = {
    "avg_engagement_by_segment": avg_engagement.to_dict(orient='records'),
    "highest_engagement_segment": highest_engagement_segment.to_dict()
}

input.code:
# Extract gender and age group from target_audience
# Example: "Men 18-24" -> gender = "Men", age_group = "18-24"
df[['Gender', 'Age_Group']] = df['target_audience'].str.split(n=1, expand=True)

# Calculate average engagement score by gender and age group
avg_engagement = df.groupby(['Gender', 'Age_Group'])['engagement_score'].mean().reset_index()

# Find the segment with the highest average engagement score
highest_engagement_segment = avg_engagement.loc[avg_engagement['engagement_score'].idxmax()]

result = {
    "avg_engagement_by_segment": avg_engagement.to_dict(orient='records'),
    "highest_engagement_segment": highest_engagement_segment.to_dict()
}

# Create an interactive bar chart for average engagement score by gender and age group
import plotly.express as px

# Prepare data for plotting
avg_engagement_df = pd.DataFrame(result["avg_engagement_by_segment"])

# Create the bar chart
fig = px.bar(
    avg_engagement_df,
    x="Age_Group",
    y="engagement_score",
    color="Gender",
    barmode="group",
    title="Average Engagement Score by Target Audience Segment",
    labels={"engagement_score": "Average Engagement Score", "Age_Group": "Age Group"},
    text="engagement_score"
)

# Customize the layout
fig.update_layout(
    yaxis_title="Average Engagement Score",
    xaxis_title="Age Group",
    legend_title="Gender",
    uniformtext_minsize=8,
    uniformtext_mode='hide'
)

# Format text on bars to 2 decimal places
fig.update_traces(texttemplate='%{text:.2f}', textposition='outside')

# Save the plot
fig.write_html(filepath)
